name: Settlement

components.pose: She stands at the edge of a small settlement in her homeland with one hand resting on a weathered post or wall, homes and people as soft shapes behind her, a calm, assessing look to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: Golden light and drifting motes gather faintly around her hand where it touches the wall, {{MAGIC}} light very soft.

notes: REALM SERIES: Settlement in her light homeland (settlement); realistic, from realms/light-lands and backgrounds/fantasy/country/light.
